chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār narrated, saying:
I said to al-Riḍā عليه السلام: A man has wealth, then he comes to his companion who sells him a pearl worth one hundred dirhams for one thousand dirhams, and defers the payment for him until a time.
He عليه السلام said: There is no harm in it. My father عليه السلام had instructed me, and I did that.

key_terms.الْمَالُ: property or wealth involved in the transaction
key_terms.تُسَاوِي: being worth or having an assessed value
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.لُؤْلُؤَةً: a pearl used here as the item being sold

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sell an item for a much higher price when payment is deferred?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question posed to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام about selling an item for a much higher deferred price than its present value. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no harm in this arrangement and mentions that his father عليه السلام instructed him to do likewise, indicating its permissibility in this context.
